def all_Bits_Set_In_The_Given_Range(n, l, r):
    """Write a python function to check whether all the bits are unset in the given range or not.

    Bits are numbered from 1 for the least-significant bit, and the
    range ``l`` to ``r`` is inclusive. Return ``True`` if every bit in
    that range is 0 in ``n``, otherwise return ``False``.
    """
    if r < l:
        return True
    if l < 1:
        l = 1
    mask = ((1 << (r - l + 1)) - 1) << (l - 1)
    return (n & mask) == 0

def test_all_unset_ranges():

    assert solution.all_Bits_Set_In_The_Given_Range(17, 2, 4) == True

def test_ranges_containing_a_set_bit():
    assert solution.all_Bits_Set_In_The_Given_Range(4, 3, 3) == False
    assert solution.all_Bits_Set_In_The_Given_Range(4, 1, 3) == False
    assert solution.all_Bits_Set_In_The_Given_Range(17, 1, 1) == False

    assert solution.all_Bits_Set_In_The_Given_Range(15, 1, 4) == False
    assert solution.all_Bits_Set_In_The_Given_Range(15, 2, 3) == False
    assert solution.all_Bits_Set_In_The_Given_Range(8, 4, 4) == False


def test_zero():
    assert solution.all_Bits_Set_In_The_Given_Range(0, 1, 1) == True
